description: Prompts the deterministic router misroutes today. Not counted as routing coverage. Each must keep reproducing its recorded misroute; when a routing fix makes one pass, tooling/routing_coverage.py --check fails until it is moved into suite.json.

cases.prompt: Fact-check the deck, then roast it, then gate the final version.
cases.reason: Multi-step request whose later step names its target only by pronoun or by "roadmap" as a verb; no single specialist scores at least min_step_score there, so the sequence rule cannot see two steps.

cases.prompt: Verify the claims in the proposal, then roadmap the work it implies.
cases.reason: Multi-step request whose later step names its target only by pronoun or by "roadmap" as a verb; no single specialist scores at least min_step_score there, so the sequence rule cannot see two steps.

cases.prompt: Fix the issues from yesterday's repo roast.
cases.reason: The roast is named as the source of the findings, not as a request; a back-reference is not a dismissed clause and repair-operator has no signal for "issues from <review>".

cases.prompt: Roast of the codebase? No. Fix the accepted findings.
cases.reason: The refusal is a separate one-word sentence after a question; neither negation nor dismissed cues look backwards across a sentence.
